**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/08/20 (Sun) 10:50
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Deliverables for coaching a leader include a customized coaching plan, progress reports, feedback reports, coaching sessions, skill-building resources, accountability check-ins, and team feedback reports.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The coaching plan should outline specific goals, objectives, areas for improvement, and action items for the leader to work on.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Regular progress reports should track the leader's progress towards goals and objectives, as well as challenges encountered.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Feedback reports should summarize feedback from a 360-degree assessment and other sources, highlighting strengths and areas for improvement.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Regular coaching sessions should provide feedback, guidance, and support in achieving goals and addressing areas for improvement.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Skill-building resources should include access to books, workshops, and online training programs to help the leader develop specific leadership skills.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Accountability check-ins should hold the leader accountable for following through on action items and commitments made during coaching sessions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Team feedback reports should summarize feedback from the leader's team, highlighting areas for improvement in the leader's style and trust-building.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] A pledge or commitment statement can create an environment of accountability within the team.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggestions for creating a pledge include a collaborative process, clear expectations, measurable goals, regular reviews, shared accountability, and public commitment.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The "stop doing, do more of, do less of, keep doing" approach can help coach an underperforming team by identifying areas for improvement and developing strategies.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The "stop doing" component helps identify non-productive behaviors to eliminate.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The "do more of" component helps prioritize areas needing more attention.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The "do less of" component identifies unproductive actions taking up resources.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The "keep doing" component identifies successful behaviors to maintain.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The tool can be used as an ongoing evaluation mechanism to decide on work requests based on team progress.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommendations for cloning a leader's capabilities include role modeling, training and development, collaborative learning, and goal setting.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Use cases for cloning capabilities include shadowing the leader, peer coaching, and role-playing exercises.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Abstract ideas for cloning capabilities include virtual reality simulations, reverse mentoring, gamification, and leadership
